claims.text: The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: trip_record.arrived_at is null, the status is CANCELLED_BY_RIDER and cancelled_by is RIDER. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and its limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event for the trip. That limb fails on the face of the record, and the anchor clause of this category cannot charge the fee.

The driver's own GPS trace places him 5,661 m from the pickup pin at his closest approach and 11,906 m at his furthest, over 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40. Not one fix falls within the 150 m arrival radius for an AIRPORT pickup, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 for the whole trace. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 is explicit that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The 15-minute window (13:53:40 to 14:08:40) fully contains the trace, so there is no gap the driver can hide in.

Even if arrival could somehow be established, the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480 second minimum dwell fixed for the AIRPORT zone class - a shortfall of 480 seconds on the trace's own shortfall_basis. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full for a waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded.

The trip was terminated by the rider, not the driver, and the cancellation_reason_code is RIDER_CHANGED_MIND. POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and requires termination by the driver at or after the dwell elapsed. This record satisfies none of that: the wrong party terminated, and the code is one the clause does not recognise. A fourth independent limb fails.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING - it has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0, so on this record no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. POL-NS-06(i) lets in-geofence intervals be summed only where a present and populated advisory carries an admissible type; with the advisory MISSING that limb is unavailable to the driver, and there are in any event no in-geofence intervals to sum. The absence is itself citable and it does not help the driver.

The in-app chat shows the driver writing 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40, and the rider replying 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40, one minute before the 14:08:40 cancellation. What the record shows is a rider cancellation prompted by a demand for SGD 120 in cash, not a rider no-show; it confirms that no limb of POL-NS-01 is met and that the fee was never chargeable.

The rider was at the pin throughout the disputed window: 41 qualifying rider fixes, every one within roughly 13 to 23 m of the pickup point, stationary at 0 km/h, far inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for an AIRPORT pickup. Any suggestion that the rider failed to show for her own car is contradicted by her own complete, admissible trace.

Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is available only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied on any limb - no arrived event, no in-radius fix, no dwell, and a reason code outside limb (d) - so no compensation is payable to this driver, and the whole disputed amount must go back to the rider.

The fare breakdown shows the contested SGD 8.00 cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the full contested amount is still held by the platform. Per POL-GEN-03, FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party, and this dispute was filed by the rider - so the SGD 8.00 runs back to her.

Every artifact this case rests on - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes fired. Under POL-GEN-02 the deciding facts are therefore carried at full weight, no confidence cap applies, and the ruling can rest on the evidence without discount.

claims.text: The trip was terminated by the rider's own election, not by any driver default: the trip_record records cancelled_by = RIDER with cancellation_reason_code = RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, and contains no driver 'arrived' event and no no-show termination. The driver never tapped a false 'arrived' marker and never abandoned the pickup, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival machinery — and the referral against the driver it carries — is not engaged on this record.

The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04: her only chat message is 'no. cancelling.', which is not a locating or coordinating message within limb (a) — it states no position, entrance, block, tower or bay, requests no position, and does not say she cannot see the vehicle. However present she may have been at the pin, limb (a) fails and POL-NS-04 does not dispose of the fee.

The rider's grievance about the driver's pre-pickup price message is not a ground of decision under the loaded policy: neither POLICY-NO-SHOW nor POLICY-GENERAL makes a fare re-quote a licence to reverse the cancellation fee, and the chargeability of the fee is fixed solely by the POL-NS-01 conditions and nothing else.

The SGD 8.00 cancellation line is arithmetically correct and raises no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the fee_schedule resolution rule yields the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), which is exactly the amount itemised in the fare_breakdown, so no mismatch can be turned against the driver who charged it.

The driver's profile clears the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and that count over completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so no withholding is triggered and the record shows no fee-farming pattern; nor does the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger fire.

Honest concession: the driver's own trace never enters the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius — his closest fix is 5,661 m from the pin — with qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. The driver does not contend that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) or (c) are met and does not rest his case on the arrival and dwell arithmetic.

ruling.explanation: Both parties should see how this was decided. The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee does not stand. POL-NS-01 is the only clause that can make a no-show fee chargeable, and it requires all four of its conditions to hold together. Not one of them does on this record. (a) The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: arrived_at is null. (b) The driver's own GPS trace, 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40, never comes closer than 5,661 m to the pickup pin at Changi Terminal 1, reaches 11,906 m at its furthest, and moves at roughly 46 km/h throughout; no fix falls inside the 150 m airport arrival radius, and qualifying_fix_count is 0. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480-second minimum dwell fixed for an AIRPORT pickup, a 480-second shortfall. (d) The trip was terminated by the rider, not the driver, on the code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which is not one of the three codes limb (d) recognises. Because limb (b) fails with no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the 15 minutes before cancellation (13:53:40 to 14:08:40, which fully contains the trace), POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the fee, and POL-NS-06 independently refunds it in full for the waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not she answered messages. Nothing displaces that. POL-NS-03 needs the driver stationary within 400 m of the pin and he was 5,661 m away at his closest approach, so it does not apply. POL-NS-05 is engaged only where a trip_record 'arrived' event is shown to be false; there is no arrival marker on this record at all, so the clause never runs and no false-arrival record is entered against the driver in referrals. On the rider's own position: her trace shows 41 qualifying fixes, every one 13 to 23 m from the pin and stationary, far inside the 200 m rider-presence radius for an airport pickup, so nothing here rests on any failure by her. POL-NS-04 does not apply either, because 'no. cancelling.' is not a locating or coordinating message, but that makes no difference, since the refund follows from the driver's trace alone. On the driver's case: his explanation that the original fare did not cover airport queue time on a holiday and that he told the rider the price before pickup so she could decide is heard, but the loaded policy does not make a mid-trip fare re-quote a ground for or against the fee, and the re-quote is not what decides this case either way. The counterparty statement carries no weight_multiplier, so it enters neither the minimum nor the maximum of the confidence cap; it is consistent with the chat log, which records the driver's message 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40 and the rider's 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-07 pays only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not satisfied on any limb. The anti-farming check would not have blocked payment in any event, since driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 against the threshold of 4 and 1 over 110 completed trips is 0.009 against the 0.08 rate, and POL-NS-09(c) and (d) do not fire. On confidence: the trip record, GPS trace, chat log and fare breakdown all read COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, and the facts that decide this case, namely no arrived event in the trip record and no in-radius fix in the trace, are carried at full weight by the trip record and the trace, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the ruling rests on unimpaired evidence. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but nothing in this ruling rests on it: the POL-NS-06(i) summing route is unavailable and unnecessary because there are no in-geofence intervals to sum. A rider-side claim about that missing advisory was discarded for not naming its issue code; it is recorded in the audit below and was not needed to reach the result. The fare arithmetic is sound in any event: SGD 8.00 is the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee of SGD 6.00 and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee of SGD 8.00, exactly as the fare breakdown itemises, so there is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d). The SGD 8.00 was charged with refund_issued_sgd 0.0; it now goes back to the rider in full.

Addressed to both parties. The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee is refunded in full to the rider.

For the driver: the fee cannot be charged, because POL-NS-01 requires all four of its conditions and none holds. (a) There is no driver 'arrived' event — EV-TRIP-00609 shows arrived_at null. (b) Your own trace, EV-GPS-00609, never enters the 150 m arrival radius for this AIRPORT pickup: your closest fix is 5,661 m from the pin and your furthest 11,906 m, with qualifying_fix_count 0 across all 49 fixes. (c) The longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480-second AIRPORT minimum. (d) The trip was terminated by the rider, not by you, with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which limb (d) does not recognise. Your own advocate concedes (b) and (c). Under POL-NS-02, where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider gets the whole fee back. POL-NS-03 does not intervene — you were never within 400 m of the pin — and POL-NS-06 points the same way on the 480-second shortfall. Two of your points are correct and I accept them: the SGD 8.00 line is arithmetically sound, since the resolution rule takes the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), so there is no POL-NS-08(d) mismatch to turn against you; and the anti-farming check clears (1 no-show termination in 30 days, a rate of 0.009, below both POL-NS-07 thresholds), so no withholding or POL-NS-09(d) escalation arises. But neither helps, because compensation under POL-NS-07 is payable only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, and it is not.

For the rider: the result is the full return of the SGD 8.00 you were charged (fare_breakdown shows payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.0). Your own additional argument under POL-NS-04 does not run — your only message, 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40, states no position, entrance, block or bay and is not a locating or coordinating message — but nothing turns on it: the refund follows from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 regardless. The driver's demand 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40 is plainly what prompted the cancellation, but I have not rested the outcome on it; the fee falls because POL-NS-01 fails, not because of the re-quote.

Confidence 0.95. The deciding facts — no arrival event and no in-radius fix — are carried by EV-TRIP-00609 and EV-GPS-00609, both COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING at weight 0.0, but it carries none of the deciding facts, so it does not cap confidence; POL-NS-06(i) could not have been invoked in any event, as there are no in-geofence intervals to sum.

No referral issues. POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged: with no 'arrived' marker at all there is no false-arrival record to refer. One open question, noted here rather than as a referral because no clause in this category produces one: the driver's request for SGD 120 in cash off-platform sits outside the NO_SHOW_CHARGE clauses, and whether it warrants separate platform attention is not something this ruling decides.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties. The SGD 8.00 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-00609 cannot stand and is refunded in full to the rider.

Why the fee fails. POL-NS-01 permits a no-show cancellation fee only where all four conditions hold, and on this record none of them does. (a) The trip record contains no driver 'arrived' event — trip_record.arrived_at is null. (b) The driver's own GPS trace never enters the 150 m arrival radius for an AIRPORT pickup: his closest fix is 5,661 m from the pin and his furthest 11,906 m, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 across all 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40 (the 15 minutes before the 14:08:40 cancellation is fully covered, so there is no gap to hide in). (c) There is no dwell at all — the longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480-second minimum fixed for an AIRPORT pickup for the zone class, a 480-second shortfall. (d) The trip was ended by the rider, not the driver, and on cancellation_reason_code RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, which limb (d) does not recognise. With limb (b) failed and no qualifying in-radius fix anywhere in the window, POL-NS-02 entitles the rider to a full refund of the fee; POL-NS-06 independently refunds in full for the waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present or replied. POL-NS-03 (wrong entrance) does not apply: the driver was moving at roughly 46 km/h and was never stationary and never within 400 m of the pin, so no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises.

On the driver's points. His concession that limbs (b) and (c) are not met is accepted and is decisive. His fare-integrity point is correct and accepted — the SGD 8.00 line equals the greater of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), so POL-NS-08(d) raises no defect against him. His anti-farming point is also correct: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1 (below 4) and 1/110 = 0.009 (below 0.08), so no withholding trigger fires. Neither point rescues the fee, because POL-NS-07 compensation requires POL-NS-01 to be satisfied in full, which it is not; no compensation is payable to the driver. The driver's '120, cash, or cancel' chat message is not itself a ground under the loaded policy for reversing the fee, and I do not reverse it on that basis — the fee fails on POL-NS-01's own limbs. POL-NS-04 (rider contact unanswered) is correctly shown not to apply, because the rider's only message, 'no. cancelling.', is not a locating or coordinating message; but the refund does not depend on that clause, and her presence at the pin (41 fixes, roughly 13 to 23 m out, stationary) is uncontradicted.

Impairment. EV-ADVIS-00609-01 (TRAFFIC_ADVISORY) is MISSING at weight_multiplier 0.0 with issue MISSING_ARTIFACT. Its absence is citable and it carries no deciding fact; it only makes POL-NS-06(i) accumulation unavailable, which changes nothing here as there are no in-geofence intervals to sum. The four carriers of the deciding facts (trip record, GPS trace, chat log, fare breakdown) are all COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes, so no confidence cap applies and the finding survives at full weight.

No referral and no escalation. POL-NS-05(ii) is not engaged because the driver never tapped a false 'arrived' marker to be caught, so no false-arrival referral arises. No POL-NS-09 trigger fires: no artifact contradiction, no repeat-party dispute pattern (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0), no anti-farming trip and no_show_disputes_30d of 0, and no deciding artifact impaired under POL-NS-08(a) to (d). The contested SGD 8.00 is returned to the rider and the charge is released.

ledger.claim: The trip record carries no driver 'arrived' event at all: trip_record.arrived_at is null, the status is CANCELLED_BY_RIDER and cancelled_by is RIDER. POL-NS-01 is deliberately conjunctive and its limb (a) requires a driver 'arrived' event for the trip. That limb fails on the face of the record, and the anchor clause of this category cannot charge the fee.

The driver's own GPS trace places him 5,661 m from the pickup pin at his closest approach and 11,906 m at his furthest, over 49 fixes from 14:00:40 to 14:08:40. Not one fix falls within the 150 m arrival radius for an AIRPORT pickup, and derived.arrival.qualifying_fix_count is 0 for the whole trace. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and POL-NS-02 is explicit that where the trace contains no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes preceding cancellation, the driver never arrived and the rider is entitled to a full refund of the cancellation fee. The 15-minute window (13:53:40 to 14:08:40) fully contains the trace, so there is no gap the driver can hide in.

Even if arrival could somehow be established, the driver's longest qualifying in-geofence run is 0 seconds against the 480 second minimum dwell fixed for the AIRPORT zone class - a shortfall of 480 seconds on the trace's own shortfall_basis. POL-NS-01 limb (c) fails, and POL-NS-06 refunds the cancellation fee in full for a waiting-period shortfall, whether or not the rider was present and whether or not the rider responded.

The trip was terminated by the rider, not the driver, and the cancellation_reason_code is RIDER_CHANGED_MIND. POL-NS-01 limb (d) recognises only RIDER_NO_SHOW, RIDER_UNREACHABLE and EXCESSIVE_WAIT, and requires termination by the driver at or after the dwell elapsed. This record satisfies none of that: the wrong party terminated, and the code is one the clause does not recognise. A fourth independent limb fails.

The traffic advisory artifact EV-ADVIS-00609-01 is MISSING - it has no payload and carries weight_multiplier 0.0, so on this record no advisory covers the pickup road in this window. POL-NS-06(i) lets in-geofence intervals be summed only where a present and populated advisory carries an admissible type; with the advisory MISSING that limb is unavailable to the driver, and there are in any event no in-geofence intervals to sum. The absence is itself citable and it does not help the driver.

ledger.claim: The in-app chat shows the driver writing 'fare is 120 now, cash, or you cancel' at 14:03:40, and the rider replying 'no. cancelling.' at 14:07:40, one minute before the 14:08:40 cancellation. What the record shows is a rider cancellation prompted by a demand for SGD 120 in cash, not a rider no-show; it confirms that no limb of POL-NS-01 is met and that the fee was never chargeable.

The rider was at the pin throughout the disputed window: 41 qualifying rider fixes, every one within roughly 13 to 23 m of the pickup point, stationary at 0 km/h, far inside the 200 m rider_presence_radius_m for an AIRPORT pickup. Any suggestion that the rider failed to show for her own car is contradicted by her own complete, admissible trace.

Driver compensation under POL-NS-07 is available only where POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full. It is not satisfied on any limb - no arrived event, no in-radius fix, no dwell, and a reason code outside limb (d) - so no compensation is payable to this driver, and the whole disputed amount must go back to the rider.

The fare breakdown shows the contested SGD 8.00 cancellation fee as CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.0, so the full contested amount is still held by the platform. Per POL-GEN-03, FULL_REFUND returns the whole contested amount to the filing party, and this dispute was filed by the rider - so the SGD 8.00 runs back to her.

Every artifact this case rests on - the trip record, the GPS trace, the chat log and the fare breakdown - is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 with no issue codes fired. Under POL-GEN-02 the deciding facts are therefore carried at full weight, no confidence cap applies, and the ruling can rest on the evidence without discount.

The trip was terminated by the rider's own election, not by any driver default: the trip_record records cancelled_by = RIDER with cancellation_reason_code = RIDER_CHANGED_MIND, and contains no driver 'arrived' event and no no-show termination. The driver never tapped a false 'arrived' marker and never abandoned the pickup, so POL-NS-05's false-arrival machinery — and the referral against the driver it carries — is not engaged on this record.

The rider is not exonerated under POL-NS-04: her only chat message is 'no. cancelling.', which is not a locating or coordinating message within limb (a) — it states no position, entrance, block, tower or bay, requests no position, and does not say she cannot see the vehicle. However present she may have been at the pin, limb (a) fails and POL-NS-04 does not dispose of the fee.

The rider's grievance about the driver's pre-pickup price message is not a ground of decision under the loaded policy: neither POLICY-NO-SHOW nor POLICY-GENERAL makes a fare re-quote a licence to reverse the cancellation fee, and the chargeability of the fee is fixed solely by the POL-NS-01 conditions and nothing else.

The SGD 8.00 cancellation line is arithmetically correct and raises no fare-integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d): the fee_schedule resolution rule yields the GREATER of the AIRPORT zone-class fee (SGD 6.00) and the RYDE_XL vehicle-tier fee (SGD 8.00), which is exactly the amount itemised in the fare_breakdown, so no mismatch can be turned against the driver who charged it.

The driver's profile clears the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 1, below the threshold of 4, and that count over completed_trips_30d of 110 is 0.009, below the 0.08 rate, so no withholding is triggered and the record shows no fee-farming pattern; nor does the POL-NS-09(d) abuse trigger fire.

Honest concession: the driver's own trace never enters the 150 m AIRPORT arrival radius — his closest fix is 5,661 m from the pin — with qualifying_fix_count 0 and a longest qualifying run of 0 seconds. The driver does not contend that POL-NS-01 limbs (b) or (c) are met and does not rest his case on the arrival and dwell arithmetic.
